IT_REFUSED_CLAIM_UPGRADE.condition: the predicate asserts a state, count or identity the named record does not admit, including a stronger state of the same kind
IT_REFUSED_CLAIM_UPGRADE.prevents: that a statement upgrades a record: COMPLETE over TRUNCATED_BOUNDED, RESOLVED over zero resolutions, a member census over an aggregate, a verified instrument over a RECORDED one, an ACTIVE suppression with no expiry, or an evidence identity with no digest

IT_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_SUBJECT.condition: two subjects have the same name
IT_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_SUBJECT.prevents: that two different digests for one artefact are both read as its identity, with the reader choosing one

IT_REFUSED_MISSING_SUBJECT.condition: the statement has no subject, or a subject has no name
IT_REFUSED_MISSING_SUBJECT.prevents: that an attestation about nothing is read as an attestation about an artefact

IT_REFUSED_PREDICATE_FIELD.condition: a required predicate field is missing or malformed, or a forbidden field is present
IT_REFUSED_PREDICATE_FIELD.prevents: that an absent field is defaulted, or that a field the predicate is not licensed to carry smuggles a second, weaker claim

IT_REFUSED_PREDICATE_TYPE.condition: the predicate type is not a registered project predicate, or a SLSA predicate type is used for a statement that is not SLSA provenance
IT_REFUSED_PREDICATE_TYPE.prevents: that an unversioned or borrowed predicate type makes a project claim look like an external specification's claim

IT_REFUSED_RECORD_ABSENT.condition: the record a predicate would restate is not present
IT_REFUSED_RECORD_ABSENT.prevents: that a statement is built from an absent record, which would assert a predicate with no source at all

IT_REFUSED_RECORD_INADMISSIBLE.condition: the source record exists but fails its own admission (A5, A6 or A7), or disagrees with the declaration it claims to record
IT_REFUSED_RECORD_INADMISSIBLE.prevents: that a statement launders a refused declaration into an admitted one, because the envelope looks authoritative

IT_REFUSED_STATEMENT_MUTATED.condition: re-reading the emitted bytes does not reproduce the canonical statement this tool writes, or the document shape is not the emitted shape
IT_REFUSED_STATEMENT_MUTATED.prevents: that a reordered, re-spaced or re-shaped document is verified as if it were the statement that was emitted

IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_ABSENT.condition: the subject file is not present when the digest is computed
IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_ABSENT.prevents: that a missing artefact is silently skipped or hashed as empty, so a statement names a file that does not exist

IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_DIGEST_FORM.condition: a subject digest names an algorithm other than sha256, or its value is not 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_DIGEST_FORM.prevents: that a Git object id, an abbreviated token or a non-hex string is read as a content digest of the bytes

IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.condition: a subject digest differs from the bytes on disk, or the predicate names a record at a digest the statement does not carry
IT_REFUSED_SUBJECT_DIGEST_MISMATCH.prevents: that a statement names an artefact it has not hashed, or carries a digest taken at another moment

IT_REFUSED_TYPE.prevents: that a document of another type (a DSSE envelope, an in-toto v0.1 statement, a bare predicate) is read as a Statement v1
